AVTTSI.NoParty: There is no party yet. The GM can create one here, or mark a group actor as the primary party in the Actors sidebar.
AVTTSI.ReadOnly: You can see the party's inventory but not change it. The GM needs to give players Owner permission on the party.
AVTTSI.Empty: The party has no items yet.
AVTTSI.DropHint: Drag items here from a compendium, a sheet or the search below.
AVTTSI.NotAnItem: Only items that can be carried can go into the party's inventory.
AVTTSI.NoAccess: The party's inventory isn't shared with you. The GM needs to give players Owner permission on the party.
AVTTSI.NoPartyActor: There is no party yet. The GM can create one here, or choose an existing actor to hold the party's coins and items.
AVTTSI.ChooseLabel: Actor to use as the party
AVTTSI.MenuSet: Use as the party's shared inventory
